meta.name: add-mattermost
meta.description: Add a self-hosted or cloud Mattermost bot channel through the Chat SDK bridge, reusing a healthy server when available and linking to official server setup guidance when needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Mattermost 机器人接进聊天频道,复用可用服务器并给出搭建指引
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你团队用 Mattermost,想让机器人常驻聊天频道。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team runs Mattermost and wants a bot living in its channels.

howto.what: 帮 Claude 接入 Mattermost 机器人频道:探测并复用已有服务器、配置 SiteURL、注册适配器、认证 bot、设置审批卡片回调,最后构建测试重启。完成后可在 Mattermost 私聊和频道发消息、文件、表情回应和处理审批卡片。
howto.when: 当你要把 Mattermost(自建或云端)加为 Claude 的聊天频道、为该频道做首次接入时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Mattermost 接成频道
say.note: 先探测 localhost:8065 等地址再让你选

say.text: 给我的 Mattermost 频道换一个新 bot token
say.note: 重跑时会问是否复用原有设置

howto.what_en: Adds a Mattermost bot channel: finds or reuses a running server, sets SiteURL, registers the adapter, authenticates the bot token, sets card callbacks, then builds and restarts. You can then chat, send files, react and approve cards.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add Mattermost (self-hosted or cloud) as a Claude chat channel, or to set up that channel for the first time.

say_en.text: Add Mattermost as a channel for me
say_en.note: Probes localhost:8065 and lets you pick a server

say_en.text: Add Mattermost using http://localhost:8065 as the URL
Give my Mattermost channel a new bot token
say_en.note: Reruns ask whether to reuse saved settings
